name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=ani_decoder). Descriptor accurately reflects body: a frame-dispatch chunk handler (slot 0 in data_fd2_animation_ani_decoder_frame_dispatch_table @ 0x5276A, first entry e76a0300 = 0x00036ae7) that fills the 768-byte palette area with one broadcast byte value. No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: ANI frame-decoder chunk handler (dispatch slot 0): fill the entire 768-byte VGA palette area (256 RGB entries) with a single byte value read from the frame stream.
logic_summary: Reads one byte from the ANI frame stream cursor (LODSB consumes *ESI++), broadcasts it across all 4 bytes of EAX (AH=AL; BX=AX; EAX<<=16; AX=BX -> EAX=bbbb), then REP STOSD with ECX=0xC0 (192 dwords = 768 bytes) writing into data_fd2_animation_ani_decoder_src_buf (palette base @ 0x52766). Equivalent to memset(src_buf, val, 768). No return value; advances stream cursor by 1.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effect: writes 768 bytes (one broadcast value) into the palette area at data_fd2_animation_ani_decoder_src_buf; advances the frame-stream cursor (ESI in binary / g_ani_cursor in C) by 1 consumed byte.

reads_globals: g_ani_cursor (file-scope static stream cursor; binary uses ESI register)
writes_globals: g_ani_cursor (file-scope static stream cursor; binary uses ESI register)
*data_fd2_animation_ani_decoder_src_buf (palette area buffer pointed to by src_buf; the global pointer itself is only read)
notes: Source (anidec.c lines 79-85) is already a correct, concise C equivalent: val=*g_ani_cursor++; memset(src_buf, val, 768). The 0xC0-dword REP STOSD in the binary == 192*4 = 768 bytes. Source comment block (lines 74-78) is accurate and concise -> keep. Ghidra plate is far more detailed (register protocol, dispatch chain, algorithm) and consistent with the source understanding -> not modified. Function is void(void) so params=[]. The binary's stream cursor is the ESI register handed off by the dispatcher fd2_ani_decoder_decode_frame_bytes; the C port models it via file-scope static g_ani_cursor.
